item.tib: spyi spungs zhi khro'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zin bris dwangs shel me long
item.coloph: ces gsang sngags spyi spungs zhi khro'i bsnyen sgrub nyams su blangs pa'i zin bris dwangs shel me long zhes bya ba/ tsha rong dge rgan bsod nams g.yung drung nas rten 'brel gyi mtshams sbyar te/ 'di ltar dgos zhes nan tan chen pos bskul ba la brten nas mkhan ming pa nyi ri shel bzhin du 'bod pas/ sman ri'i brang du brtsams pa dge bar gyur cig/
